svg.title: zdb on S3: a block read checks the memory block cache, then the local NVMe chunk cache, then S3
svg.desc: Six reads of blocks from one SSTable, one hop per frame. The first misses memory, misses the NVMe chunk cache, fetches the 128 KiB chunk of the object that holds the block from S3 in one GET, stores the chunk on NVMe and the decoded block in memory, and is served. A read of a neighbouring block misses memory but hits the chunk on NVMe, with no S3 call. A repeated read is served from memory. In all, two S3 GETs serve six reads.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: ZDB ON S3 · A BLOCK READ FALLS THROUGH THREE TIERS
